mechanics.claim: Draven gains an Adoration stack when he catches a Spinning Axe, kills a non-champion, or destroys a turret.
mechanics.quote: When '''Draven''' catches a ''{{ai|Spinning Axe|Draven}}'', kills a non-champion, or destroys a {{tip|turret}}, he gains a {{tip|stack}} of ''Adoration''.

mechanics.claim: Killing an enemy champion consumes all Adoration stacks for bonus gold, which does not affect damage or survival.
mechanics.quote: he consumes all of his ''Adoration'' stacks and gains {{g|25 + (2{{times}}stacks) '''bonus''' gold}}

mechanics.claim: Draven loses half his Adoration stacks upon death.
